// README: TEMPLATE. Copy to the host as appsettings.Production.json and replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. Never commit the filled-in copy. Secrets (the database connection string, owner bootstrap password, webhook/connector secrets) are NOT stored here: set them as environment variables on the service account, for example ConnectionStrings__PenguinPlankDatabase and OwnerBootstrap__InitialPassword.
// AllowedHosts: Restrict to the private DNS name served over HTTPS.
// Kestrel: HTTPS only. The certificate comes from the Windows certificate store (private key never in a file or in git). The API sets Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookies unconditionally (AuthServiceCollectionExtensions), so plain HTTP cannot carry a session.
// FileStore: RootPath MUST be outside the web root and is the folder the nightly backup copies. Use a dedicated data volume.
// RateLimiting: Per-client fixed-window limits (429 when exceeded). Login is keyed by remote address, costly operations (media upload, audit queries) by authenticated user.
